what: When one slide of the carousel becomes the current one, the photo settles from 1.15× over 5s (cubic-bezier(.33,1,.68,1)) and sharpens over 2s (cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)), after 1.2s a wavy line is drawn from the left over 1.5s, and at 1.75s a light spreads once over the line for 2s. When another slide becomes current, the photo blurs over 2s and then returns to its initial scale, and the line is erased after 5s.

options.--fx-settle: Distance the photo sinks (via style), default 5s
options.--fx-fade: Duration for the photo to come into focus (via style), default 2s
options.--fx-hold: Time until the line is removed after another section takes over (via style), default 5s
options.[data-fx-part=line]: Slot holding a wave-line drawing (child, optional) — the svg inside is drawn at screen width and revealed as the slot width opens
options.[data-fx-part=glow]: Light pattern cell (child, optional) — svg with a light gradient painted in the same shape as the line
options..swiper-slide-active · [data-active]: Current section indicator — on this element or the slide right above. Meshes directly with Swiper fade
